elements.text: Who I Am and Why You Should Keep Reading

elements.html:
I once stood exactly where you are. A hired marketing employee, building chatbots, running ads, putting together landing pages for other people. A little of each skill. None of them big enough to call myself an “expert”.

For 3 years, I tried selling many things, and all of them fizzled. Some nights I lay awake asking myself: “Maybe I really am not cut out for this path”.

Then AI exploded and I started combining my small pieces of skill with AI, and everything changed. I did not suddenly get smarter. I just had the right tools.

Today, I have packed the shortest, simplest road from having nothing to sell to having a real digital product into a 50-page ebook. It is what I wish someone had handed me 3 years ago.

elements.text: The Moment I Understood What I Was Really Selling

Last June. I met a younger cousin who had just graduated and was in her first year as an accountant. She complained: “I am struggling with Excel, and every month-end report takes me a whole night. Can anyone teach me quickly?”

It startled me.

Because 5 years ago, I was that girl too. I spent a whole year fumbling with pivot tables, vlookup, conditional formatting. Nobody to show me. Digging it all up on Google. Some things took me 3 months to understand, and now I can explain them in 10 minutes.

That evening I opened my laptop and ran a test. I typed into Claude: “Help me pack my 5 years of accounting Excel experience into a 30-page ebook for people new to the field”.

Within 4 hours, I had a draft. Over the next 3 days, I edited, added personal stories, added a checklist. On day 7, the ebook was done. I sold it to my cousin for 99k to thank her for giving me the idea.

Two weeks later, she texted: “Sis, it only took me 2 weeks to get my report done in 2 hours instead of 8. I shared your ebook with 3 roommates and they want to buy it too. Are you selling?”

I stared at the screen for a very long time.

I realized something that 5 years of grinding as an employee never taught me: I was not selling. I was packaging what I once stumbled over, so the people who come after lose one year less than I did.

What you call “I have nothing special” is actually your asset. Someone out there, today, is sitting in front of Google looking for a way to solve exactly the problem you got past 3 years ago. They are paying with time, with tears, with a feeling of helplessness.

The question is not “am I good enough to teach”. The question is: “Do I let them fumble for 5 years the way I did, or do I package it up for them?”

That is the moment this ebook was born.

elements.text: Imagine 8 Days From Now

elements.html:
Saturday evening, the week after next. You sit down at your familiar desk. Open your email.

There is a new subject line: “Payment received: 147,000 VND from [Buyer name]”.

It is not a large sum. You know that. It is something much bigger than 147k.

It is physical proof. Proof that your 5 years of experience has a price. Proof that you are not just “settling”. Proof that you have just crossed a psychological threshold you hesitated at for 2 years.

You walk down to the living room. Your spouse (or your mother) is watching TV. You do not brag. You just say quietly: “I made my first sale today.” They look up at you and see someone a little different.

You go back upstairs. Open a blank Google Doc. Start thinking about your second digital product.

That is the breakthrough moment this ebook is designed to bring you to. In exactly 7 days.
